asideNextText: Want it sorted instead of shuffled? Sort Lines in Text & Writing orders any list A–Z.
asideText: Everything is generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness. Nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

faq.a: It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator (crypto.getRandomValues) with rejection sampling and unbiased shuffling — the same quality of randomness used by security software, not the predictable Math.random().
This returns one shuffled list. The Team Generator splits a list into groups. Same fair shuffle underneath, different output.
faq.q: How is this different from the Team Generator?

faq.a: No — every non-empty line you paste appears exactly once in the output, character-for-character; only the order changes.
faq.q: Are entries ever lost or changed?

heroSubtitle: Paste a list, get it back in a provably fair random order.
metaDescription: Shuffle any list into a random order instantly — speaking orders, playlists, question banks. Cryptographically fair Fisher–Yates shuffle, runs in your browser.
title: List Randomizer — Shuffle a List Online | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: Don't shuffle data whose order carries meaning you still need (rankings, steps, timelines) without keeping the original — random order is destructive once you overwrite it.
It shuffles lines only; it can't randomize columns inside a line or shuffle a spreadsheet's rows by key.
